Yes, but the differences are mainly to do with the Wars. For example, in portrait mode, there's more chance of Missclicking an item just by trying to reposition your kart, whereas in landscape mode, it's impossible to Missclick an item.
But as far as the TT is concerned, the one thing I can say is that portrait mode has the advantage of giving you access to the hop cancel technique before a skid, whereas in landscape it's almost impossible to master it, or at least to be able to do it as you please.
